name: Amendments by the committee responsible – separate votes
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on circularity requirements for vehicle design and on management of end-of-life vehicles, amending Regulations (EU) 2018/858 and 2019/1020 and repealing Directives 2000/53/EC and 2005/64/EC
part_text: (aa) In the case of sale of used, remanufactured or refurbished parts and components to consumers, the economic operators, including on-line traders, shall ensure that those parts and components are able to maintain their required functions and performance through normal use and comply with other requirements applicable to the goods sold in accordance with Directive (EU) 2019/771. Those requirements shall not apply to the non-commercial sale or exchange of used, remanufactured or refurbished spare parts and components.
